failing.rule: A refund goes back the way it was paid: a part-card, part-store-credit order is refunded to each in the amounts paid
failing.example: Meera paid Rs 1,500 for a lamp (Rs 1,000 card + Rs 500 store credit) and gets a full refund: Rs 1,000 to her card and Rs 500 as store credit

failing.rule: A partial refund on a mixed-payment order is split in the same proportion as the payment
failing.example: Meera (Rs 1,000 card + Rs 500 store credit) changed her mind on day 20 and gets Rs 750: Rs 500 to her card and Rs 250 as store credit
